title: Nitpicker --json output
description: The one JSON object a nitpicker run with --json prints on stdout: the result of a comparison run or of --all, or the error that stopped the run. Optional fields are left out when they have no value.

failure.description: The run stopped before it had a result, for example on an unknown argument or a repository with no commits.

mode.description: diff for a comparison with the base, all for --all.

status.description: The outcome of the gate: passed (exit code 0), failed (1: failing findings or failing tests) or error (2: a tool error left the run incomplete).

exitCode.description: The exit code of the process; 0 with --defer-exit whatever the status.

base.description: The ref the comparison ran against and how it was chosen.

noChanges.description: Nothing changed since the merge base, so nothing was checked.

findings.description: The failing findings, in the order the reports list them. Unreached mutants of one function are one entry, and a function lists at most three surviving mutants and then one entry for the rest.

partialRun.description: Only some analyzers ran (--analyzer); run without it before you finish.

reports.description: Absolute path of the folder with the full reports (report.txt and the JSON files).

failing.description: Failing findings, each mutant counted on its own.

byArea.description: Failing findings per area, in the order to fix them.

reportOnly.description: Findings that never fail the gate (descriptive); listed in the reports.

held.description: Comparison runs: findings the base already had and the change did not make worse; listed in held-findings.json.

message.description: The message on one line, without the exception sentence when `exception` carries it.

allowedForm.description: The part of the message that names what to write instead.

exception.description: The entry that accepts the finding when it is intended; its reason is a placeholder to replace.

exceptionList.description: Set when `exception` goes to a list other than the top-level `exceptions` of nitpicker.config.json.

helpUri.description: The rule reference entry of the rule.

folded.description: The entry stands for several mutants; the message says how many.

snapshot.description: Which checkout the error happened in, such as head or base.

rule.description: Set on the errors that carry a rule, such as failing tests.

headline.description: The first line of the error; report.txt and tool-errors.json have the full text.
